limitations: Saved metrics describe the February 2026 experiment, not live traffic or a new evaluation.
The checkpoint used 512 training examples from a prepared 96000-example pool.
Prepared splits contain overlapping normalized text. Do not call the recorded result leakage-free.
Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities of correctness.
No evaluation of present-day headlines, other languages, or out-of-domain detection is recorded.
This application performs classification, not summarization or news aggregation.
This build runs locally. No production deployment, cloud operation, or uptime is claimed.
